understanding.goal_understanding: The goal was to navigate the grid and complete every level by stepping onto each goal cell while carrying a piece whose shape, color, and rotation exactly match the goal's requirements.
understanding.mechanics_understanding: Each move consumes one stamina. Walls block movement, and blocked_directions must be checked before acting. Shape modifiers cycle shapes 0–5, color modifiers cycle colors orange to blue to green to red and back to orange, and rotation modifiers turn the piece 90 degrees clockwise. Matching all three attributes activates a goal when entered. Stamina reaching zero costs a life and restores maximum stamina; losing all lives ends the game.
